records.description: ColdStart is a data and marketing tool for companies that predicts and distributes target content instantly using AI.

records.name: Sapien Labs
records.tagline: In-silico trial engine for psychiatry programs
records.description: Sapien Labs builds trial-grade external control arms from real-world clinical data so clinical teams can evaluate psychiatry programs without recruiting as many control patients.

records.name: Oumua Inc
records.tagline: AI-guided breathing trainer with companion app
records.description: Oumua pairs a portable breathing trainer with an app that runs guided sessions, lung tests, and personalized programs. It looks real, but the launch is hardware-led rather than a core digital product.

records.name: Tellme
records.tagline: The conversational layer for the real world
records.description: Tellme turns any physical object or place into a conversational AI experience. Point your phone at museum exhibits, artworks, or real-world objects and instantly ask questions, explore stories, and receive personalised answers powered by computer vision and generative AI. Already live across museums in the UK with thousands of visitor interactions.

records.name: OptimizeGEO.ai
records.tagline: Agentic GEO platform for AI search visibility
records.description: OptimizeGEO helps brands win visibility, accuracy, and trust in AI answers. It tracks how your brand appears across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and other answer engines, measuring visibility, share of voice, competitor presence, and accuracy. Then AI agents identify issues, prioritize fixes, and improve your content, citations, website, PR, and AI readiness, so your brand shows up more often, more accurately, and with measurable business impact.

records.name: Volume
records.tagline: Open banking checkout for one-click payments
records.description: Volume offers merchants an open banking checkout that cuts payment friction, lowers fees, and supports bank-based payments across the UK, Germany, and other markets.

records.name: Klava AI
records.tagline: AI bid comparison for construction tenders
records.description: Klava AI covers the full construction tendering workflow, from the bill of quantities to award documentation. Core feature: AI analysis of contract preambles to flag the gaps that become expensive change orders

records.name: DealSync
records.tagline: End the email tennis and run deals from one workspace
records.description: Most legal tech serves one side of a transaction and bolts on a portal for the counterparty. DealSync is the opposite. One workspace where both parties to a deal collaborate live: licensor and licensee, buyer and seller, working on the same documents with the same audit trail and AI-assisted drafting. Launching first with IP licensing. Brand owners, agencies, and IP counsel running royalty schedules, approvals, and licence packs without the email tennis.

records.name: HackerPulse
records.tagline: Measures AI impact across engineering teams
records.description: HackerPulse measures how AI affects engineering output with quality-adjusted metrics, review tax, capacity scenarios, and board-ready reporting for software teams.

records.name: Best Technicians Technologies LTD
records.tagline: Home services marketplace for local technicians
records.description: Best Technicians connects customers with local plumbers, electricians, handymen, and other service pros through a booking app. It looks functional, but it is a hyper-local services marketplace rather than a strong PH-style launch.

records.name: ParaHubXM
records.tagline: Parametric weather insurance for agriculture
records.description: ParaHubXM is a weather-focused InsurTech that delivers fully transparent parametric insurance solutions for agriculture and weather-exposed risks. Through our proprietary ground weather stations network and machine learning models trained on hyperlocal and asset-level station data, we provide low cost policies, rapid payouts in days not months, and data transparency, significantly reducing basis risk and closing the protection gap for farmers, communities, and the insurance market.

records.name: Pressmaster.ai
records.tagline: Thought leadership AI for founders and teams
records.description: Pressmaster helps founders and teams turn interviews, ideas, and source material into posts, articles, research, and publishing workflows in their own voice. It combines an AI twin, trend discovery, content planning, and multi-platform publishing in one system.

records.name: Rhuna
records.tagline: Payments and ticketing infrastructure for live events
records.description: Rhuna gives live entertainment operators a white-label stack for payments, ticketing, access control, and data across venues and events.

records.name: Comfi
records.tagline: B2B financing for SME suppliers in the UAE
records.description: Comfi helps UAE B2B suppliers get paid upfront while offering buyers 30 to 90 day terms. It packages invoice discounting, BNPL, and dealer financing into a faster funding workflow.

records.name: Hushday
records.tagline: Private flash-sale marketplace for luxury fashion
records.description: Hushday gives members access to invitation-only flash sales for luxury fashion and beauty, with curated drops, secure checkout, and delivery across the UAE.

records.name: FoodFix
records.tagline: Fixing the broken journey for homecooks, creators & brands.
records.description: You watch a recipe on TikTok. Then you pause the video, open Notes to write down ingredients. Then you open your supermarket app. Then you lose motivation halfway through. FoodFix turns that chaos into one seamless journey: Watch creator recipes → Plan your meals → Shop groceries → Cook with step-by-step guidance. 40K home cooks. 100+ creators. Partnered with Kaufland & Wolt. Live on iOS & Android.

records.name: SUN
records.tagline: AI audio courses and book summaries on demand
records.description: SUN turns any topic, question, or nonfiction book into a personalized audio course, podcast, or summary. It lets listeners choose length, depth, and voice, then ask follow-up questions while listening.

records.name: Contents.com
records.tagline: Enterprise platform for AI content operations
records.description: Contents.com helps large teams create, govern, translate, and approve branded content across markets with AI tools, workflows, and auditability in one platform.

records.name: Bookmypet
records.tagline: Pet care booking app for UAE and Saudi owners
records.description: Bookmypet lets pet owners book grooming, boarding, vets, pet taxis, and other services from vetted providers in one app across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

records.name: Medijobs
records.tagline: Medical hiring marketplace for Romanian employers
records.description: MEDIjobs is a recruitment marketplace that connects healthcare employers with doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and other medical specialists. It looks real, but it is region-specific and less aligned with a PH-style launch.

records.name: Relocal
records.tagline: Healthcare hiring and relocation platform
records.description: Relocal helps hospitals hire pre-screened international healthcare professionals and manage screening, visa support, and relocation in one workflow.

records.name: Bling
records.tagline: Run enterprise hiring loops autonomously
records.description: Bling helps enterprises meet their frontline hiring quota by running the entire hiring loop autonomously from application to screening to interviews, offer rollout, background checks, and onboarding. Our AI system engages with thousands of candidates simultaneously and moves them from interest to offer in under 10 mins. We own the outcome: person hired. With 1M+ applicants processed, our Bling OS flywheel compounds across data, workflow, and AI intelligence.

records.name: Mystocks.Inc
records.tagline: African stocks and bonds trading platform
records.description: mystocks.africa gives investors access to African stocks, bonds, and pre-IPO deals across multiple exchanges, with market data and remote trading from one platform.
